genes.name: lattice_init
genes.hypothesis: Optimal configurations look like hexagonal (2D) or close-packed (3D) lattice patches bent into a round shape, so starting from a jittered lattice patch lands in good basins more often than starting from uniform points in a ball.
genes.predicted: lower mean ratio at short budgets on both train instances; smaller effect at long budgets
genes.author: seed

genes.name: smooth_presolve
genes.hypothesis: SLSQP from a raw random start spends its iterations untangling the configuration and often stops early; a cheap L-BFGS descent on a log-sum-exp surrogate of log(max d^2 / min d^2) first moves the start close to a basin, so each local solve is faster and ends lower.
genes.predicted: more local solves per second and a lower mean ratio; neutral if SLSQP already converges from raw starts
genes.author: seed

genes.name: basin_hop
genes.hypothesis: Good local optima cluster: perturbing the current optimum by a fraction of the minimum distance and re-solving explores neighbouring basins more efficiently than independent restarts.
genes.predicted: lower best ratio at n16 and d3n14 for budgets of a few seconds or more
genes.author: seed

genes.name: slsqp_maxiter
genes.hypothesis: Iteration cap of each SLSQP solve: too low stops before the tie system is resolved, too high wastes time on starts that are in bad basins anyway.
genes.author: seed

genes.name: lattice_jitter
genes.hypothesis: Gaussian jitter of the lattice start, in units of the lattice spacing: enough to break the lattice's symmetry and reach different basins, not so much that the lattice structure is lost.
genes.author: seed

genes.name: smooth_beta
genes.hypothesis: Sharpness of the log-sum-exp surrogate on log distances: low values balance all distances, high values track the true extremes but make the surrogate stiff.
genes.author: seed

genes.name: hop_sigma
genes.hypothesis: Size of a basin-hopping kick in units of the minimum distance: small kicks fall back into the same optimum, large ones are equivalent to a restart.
genes.author: seed

genes.name: hop_patience
genes.hypothesis: Consecutive non-improving hops before giving up on the current basin and starting afresh; trades depth around one optimum against breadth.
genes.author: seed
